LinkedIn hustle culture has completely lost its mind.

Hi there hello.

Today we’re taking another look at the absolute lunatics of LinkedIn, where every normal life event can become a leadership lesson, a productivity flex, or a very serious post about business. From CEOs trying to control employees’ PlayStations, to people logging on from hospital beds and wedding days, to AI-generated LinkedIn posts full of corporate nonsense, this video explores what happens when work becomes everyone’s whole personality.

I did not log in to LinkedIn for any of this. I have a doctor’s note.
